name: secret-scanner
description: Static secret/token scanning for codebases and git repos: detects leaked credentials (AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, Google, Slack, private keys, JWTs) using the gitleaks v8.30.1 pattern table + Shannon entropy gating + allowlist noise filters. Stdlib-only Python script, offline by design, with JSON/Markdown/text reports, redaction, and a CI exit-code gate. Triggers: 'secret scan', 'проверь секреты', 'leaked token', 'утечка ключей', 'scan for keys', 'hardcoded credentials', 'git secrets check', 'проверить на секреты'.
author: best
